paper_title: A Controllable Examination for Long-Context Language Models
caption: The bar chart of performance by different attributes on the 2-retrieval task. For simplicity, we abbreviate the names of all instruct models.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of different attributes on a multi-retrieval task, as measured across various model configurations. The horizontal axis displays the model configurations labeled as "Qwen2.5-7b-1M", "Interlm3-8b", "ProLong-8b", and "Qwen2.5-7b", categorized in this order. The vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, marked at regular intervals of 20. Each category contains five grouped bars, each representing a specific attribute: "city", "hobby", "university", "major", and "birthdate", colored in teal, orange, blue, pink, and green, respectively. The approximate heights of the bars vary, with values from 82 to 90 for bars under "Qwen2.5-7b-1M", slightly lower values around 50 to 85 under "Interlm3-8b", values for the bar ranging from 25 to 85 under "ProLong-8b", and with values of the bar in the range 2 to 20 under "Qwen2.5-7b". The bars are not sorted in a particular order, and no visual emphasis, such as shading or outlining, is applied to any specific bar. Except the Qwen model, all the other models have the "birthdate" bar being the highest. None of the bars have values given. On top of the bar, a text is given "Accuracy by different attributes on multi-retrieval task (n=2). A legend is given top right.
